mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1-month increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.1% indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.5 during late-cycle expansion signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 2% annualized indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL acceleration exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals inflationary pressure, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1-month PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.2% and FEDFUNDS below 0.2% indicate labor market strength with accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.2% in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS < 0.2%
regime_hint: labor market strength with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 during post-recession recovery indicates waning housing momentum, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines in post-recession recovery.
